scope: P1/P2/P3 follow-up operations plus a separately subtotaled cross-domain counterexample group.
cost_unit: One operation ledger invocation with its recorded cost. Connector-internal HTTP request counts and human labor time were not measured.

category_definitions.content_read: Direct substantive source body, code, patch, issuer event/release discussion, or additional section. Re-reading is still an operation; it does not add an independent work.
category_definitions.metadata_or_bibliographic_read: Commit collections, trees, release hashes, check-run collections and bibliographic/date/program corroboration. Conference pages were accessed but are separated from the paper's substantive reading.
category_definitions.search: Discovery queries and previews; no directly read original is implied.
category_definitions.access_failed: Explicitly recorded access failures, including retries.
category_definitions.summary_only: A substituted/rewritten summary was returned, rather than the original body.

original_experiment_reference_only.note: The 70 original operations remain separate. No combined experimental denominator or postseal hit credit is computed.

decision_normalization.lossless_originals: Each CSV row retains exact original field names and values in raw_decision_json, and links its originating CSV and row number.
decision_normalization.blank_policy: Blank normalized fields mean the original ledger did not provide a separate field; they are not observed zero or a factual denial.
decision_normalization.date_policy: Unverified, compound and current-read dates are preserved as written; no date is inferred from a URL.

external_references_preserved.note: Retained exactly; not reclassified as a postseal source.
